sqlMap.select:
SELECT RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO, RE.EMP_NAME, RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, RE.FINAL_SCHOOL, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)FINAL_EDU, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.POST_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_TYPE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.SEX_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)SEX, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(RE.EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY/MM/DD'))/ 12)AGE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.NATIONALITY_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)NATIONALITY_CODE, RE.EMP_TELPHONE, RI.FINAL_CONFIRM, RI.FINAL_REMARK, AVG.SCORE FROM REC_INTERVIEW RI,REC_EMPLOYEE RE,REC_AFFIRM RA, (SELECT RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO, AVG(RA.Score) as SCORE FROM REC_AFFIRM RA group by RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO) AVG WHERE RI.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO AND RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO AND AVG.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO AND RA.AFFIRM_LEVEL = 1 AND RI.FINAL_CONFIRM = #FINAL_CONFIRM:NUMRIC#
UPPER(RE.EMP_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#EMP_NAME:VARCHAR#||'%')
RE.POST_TYPE_CODE = #POST_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#
RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE = #FINAL_EDU:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO desc
sqlMap.update: UPDATE REC_INTERVIEW SET FINAL_CONFIRM = #affirmFlag:VARCHAR#, FINAL_REMARK = #FINAL_REMARK:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #createBy:VARCHAR# WHERE REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO HR_EMPLOYEE_RECRUIT (PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, EMPID, ACTIVITY, DATA_SOURCES, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_IP ) VALUES (#PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#, #EMPID:VARCHAR#, 0, 0, SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #CREATED_IP:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #UPDATED_IP:VARCHAR# )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_EMPLOYEE_RECRUIT SET (LOCAL_NAME, JOIN_TYPE, IDCARD_NO, SEXCODE, NATIONALITY_CODE, DOB, COMPANY_PHONE, ADDRESS_CONTENT, EMAIL, IDCARD_START_DATE, ISSUING_AUTHORITY, MARITAL_STATUS_CODE, GRADUATION_ACHIEVEMENT, AVERAGE_SCORE, LANGUAGE_ABILITY ) = (SELECT RE.EMP_NAME, '400429', PKG_DECRYPT.ENCRYPT_DES(RE.CERT_NUMBER), RE.SEX_CODE, RE.NATIONALITY_CODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RE.EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY'), PKG_DECRYPT.ENCRYPT_DES(RE.EMP_TELPHONE), RE.EMP_ADDRESS, RE.EMP_EMAIL, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RE.IDCARD_START_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY'), RE.IDCARD_ADDRESS, RE.MARITAL_STATUS_CODE, RE.GRADUATION_ACHIEVEMENT, RE.AVERAGE_SCORE, RE.LANGUAGE_ABILITY FROM REC_INTERVIEW RI,REC_EMPLOYEE RE WHERE RI.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO AND RI.FINAL_CONFIRM = '1' AND REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#) WHERE PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO HR_EDUCATION_RECRUIT (SEQ, PERSON_ID, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_IP) VALUES (HR_EDU_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #CREATED_IP:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #UPDATED_IP:VARCHAR#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_EDUCATION_RECRUIT SET (FINAL_DEGREE_WHETHER, INSTITUTION_NAME, DEGREE_CODE, END_DATE, SUBJECT) = (SELECT 'Y', RE.FINAL_SCHOOL, RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RE.FINAL_GRAD_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'MM/YYYY'), SUBJECT FROM REC_INTERVIEW RI,REC_EMPLOYEE RE WHERE RI.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO AND RI.FINAL_CONFIRM = '1' AND REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#) WHERE PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
